findings.label: d/g90ec2f781421-6
findings.reason: The change makes check with no path and no --store default to .smysl/store instead of stdin, so the recorded premise that check reads stdin when no path no longer holds.
findings.text:
Set stdin to /dev/null for dispatch test commands.
fmt and check read stdin when no path; inherited terminal would hang instead of failing.
